sticker.back: What it is: Odysee, a video site built on a network, LBRY; uploads go to the network. What you hold: an account, by email and password; a channel. What you give up: a removed video leaves the site; the network keeps it, its help page says. The wrong idea: no rules. Named as an example, not a recommendation. Checked 2026-11-23.
sticker.line: Off the site is not off the network.
